summary: Backend refactor regression + new /api/benchmark/nudge fully verified. 45/45 backend pytest tests pass (iter61 + iter60 + iter59). Frontend UI verified: RebenchmarkNudgeBanner (testID=rebenchmark-nudge-banner) renders on Home when nudge.required=true with reason text 'Recent illness, injury or return to training' and Start CTA correctly routes to /benchmark; bell-pill opens NotificationsModal; notification-rebenchmark appears as top row; notif-start-benchmark navigates to /benchmark. After restore to couch-to-road + clean check-in, nudge returns required=false, status=submaximal, planId=couch-to-road. greenlantern LEFT RESTORED to couch-to-road with clean check-in.
action_items: Testing-only note (no code change required): Playwright .click(force=true) does not always trigger react-native-web Pressable's onPress on GlassPill (bell-pill). Using element.click() via page.evaluate() works. If future automated tests target GlassPill/bell, prefer JS click. Not a user-facing bug — real touch/tap works in device/browser.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~2000+ lines even after extracting models/services/routes — future iterations could continue splitting (workouts, coach, benchmark, connections modules).
routes/system.py exposes /api/reports without auth by design (public review PDFs); allow-list keeps path-traversal safe.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: temporarily assigned ride-stronger + injury flag to greenlantern to exercise required-nudge, then RESTORED to couch-to-road + clean check-in. Verified final state via /api/benchmark/nudge={required:false, status:submaximal, planId:couch-to-road}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend restructure (core.py / db.py / models.py / services/ / routes/) is stable — imports resolved, no circular deps, behaviour identical (all iter59/iter60 tests still green). /api/benchmark/nudge is deterministic (uses services.benchmark_decision), returns {required,status,planId,planLevel,reason,recommendedTestId,recommendedTestName}. Frontend NotificationsModal builds live 'rebenchmark' row from useBenchmarkNudge only when required=true. bell-pill lives inside HeroRoute at ~y=161 for mobile viewport; if Playwright .click() misfires on it, fall back to page.evaluate(document.querySelector(...).click()). greenlantern is on couch-to-road + clean check-in.
